description: This is a shell script used in OpenWrt for controlling LED indicators during different system states such as boot, failsafe, running, and upgrade. The script utilizes functions from external scripts to set LED states accordingly.

methods.name: set_led_state
methods.description: Sets the system LED to reflect the current system state, blinking or turning off LEDs based on the provided argument.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Determines whether to update the LED state based on current system variables.
